title: salix × fragilis f. sanguinea
intro: Salix × fragilis f. sanguinea, commonly known as Weeping Willow, is a hybrid plant resulting from the cross between Salix alba (White Willow) and Salix fragilis (Crack Willow). The health benefits of Salix × fragilis f. sanguinea include its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory, reducing pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its salicylic acid content, which acts as a natural analgesic and anti-pyretic. The bioactive constituents of Salix × fragilis f. sanguinea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
